notes_list.title: Kathak & Major Gharanas
notes_list.basic_overview: • Kathak: Primary classical dance form of Northern India. • Core Gharanas: Lucknow Gharana (Bhava/Expression), Jaipur Gharana (Speed/Footwork), Banaras Gharana.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
👑 Revision Extra Info:
- Lucknow Gharana was patronized by Nawab Wajid Ali Shah.
- Prominent Exponents: Birju Maharaj, Lacchu Maharaj.
- Raigarh Gharana is also associated with Kathak, established by Raja Chakradhar Singh.
